args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring and tests/test_money.py already specify banker's rounding
(ROUND_HALF_EVEN), but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. This
mismatch caused the nightly build to fail on
tests/test_money.py::test_half_even.

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Change the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the documented behavior and FIN-212.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: passed, including `test_half_even`.
